Ana (marketing): Heads up — need a 1-pager + webinar narrative for next week's enterprise push. Focus: secure serving, SLAs, deploy modes. Goal: field-ready asset + slide for webinar + 3 benchmark callouts. Draft by Wed EOD?

Jordan (field): Got it. Can we call out perf numbers vs. self-hosted baseline? Need rack-level latency and cost delta.

Simon (product): We have benchmark set from lab run: p95 latency 85ms on Dedicated, 180ms on Hosted w/ caching. Cost delta ~40% vs unmanaged. I'll drop raw numbers+table.

Lee (growth): Routing ask: inbound QA -> MQL lead flow? Suggest rule: High-security tag -> AE + Solutions Eng + Private deployment SDR. Low-commit -> self-serve + webinar invite.

Ana (marketing): Love that. Need a concise tagline for the one-pager (20 chars). Options: 'Secure Serving, Simplified' or 'Predictable Inference for Regulated Teams' — which?

Jordan (field): Prefer second. More explicit for compliance buyers.

Simon (product): For webinar narrative — 15 min bench walk, 20 min customer panel, 10 min live Q&A. We'll show fallbacks and routing story.

Lee (growth): CTA: 'Get a tailored SLA estimate' button -> capture preferred infra + region + expected qps. That will feed inbound routing.

DeployBot: doc link uploaded: https://redwood-docs/internal/marketing/secure-serving-launch-draft-v1.md

Ana (marketing): Thanks. Assigning owners: Jordan -> field checklist + customer quotes; Simon -> benchmark appendix; Lee -> routing rules + GTM tagging; I'll assemble copy and slides. Deadline Wed 3pm. Ping if blocked.

Jordan (field): Will pull two customer quotes by Tue.

Simon (product): Dropping numbers in doc now. ping me if you need raw logs.

Lee (growth): I'll prototype GA4 event mapping and Slack-based lead alert for AE.
